scope: CPU-only move library and bank-plan labelling API
spec: E:/agent-work/_sol/tracks_spec.md, Move library and task rules

commits.subject: coopmwm moves: shared observable move library and bank-plan labels (T1A)

receipt_commit: The separate commit adding this receipt follows the implementation commit; see git log on c4/moves.

api.Move: frozen dataclass: Move(family, members, onset, hold, depth); actors property; to_dict()/from_dict()
api.candidates: candidates(obs_state, numpy.random.Generator, n) -> list[Move]; exactly n non-baseline candidates

obs_state.rows: only that CAV's observable sensing/V2V rows: vid, s_m, v_mps, lane, is_cav

api.offsets: offsets(move, t, state=None) -> {cav_id: acceleration offset in m/s^2}; t is an integer elapsed second

offset_state.accel_bounds: optional existing executor (lower, upper) acceleration bounds
offset_state.s_m: optional {cav_id: observable longitudinal position}; used for immediate wall release at the merge-zone boundary

api.from_plan: from_plan(verified_plan) -> Move; accepts a bare plan, receipt with chosen_plan, or individual per_seed_v1/all8 example with plan

semantics.members: 1..4 distinct CAV ids; candidates always include self, exclude HDVs, and restrict partners to the registered 100m observable/V2V range
semantics.ranges_source: variety.VARIETY_REGISTERED: onset 0..30s, hold 20..90s, depth 0.3..1.0; integer-second windows
semantics.offset_shape: ease_off and gap_open ease members[0]; wall and ramp_assist ease all members; -depth during [onset,onset+hold), zero outside
semantics.wall: upstream multi-lane members inside registered wall span; sampled window releases by constant-speed observable arrival; current s_m state releases all members at the merge boundary
semantics.clamp: with resolved state, active base+offset is clipped to [max(accel_min,-v/dt), min(accel_max,1.2,(allowed-v)/dt)]; correction is relative to the ORIGINAL base command
semantics.executor_contract: Pass current observable state for online feasibility and wall-release guards. Without resolved state offsets are nominal; existing single-writer runtime feasibility clamp and speedMode 27 remain authoritative. Infeasible seconds get zero move correction. none/release preserve base identity.
semantics.baseline: none is explicit via none_move; planner adds it separately to candidates
semantics.labelling: structured variety tags supply family; untagged negative-offset structure supplies fallback family; largest-braking-energy members limit arity; gap_open reorders its easing actor first; integer onset/hold and continuous depth minimise squared offset error within that family/member projection, zero-padded beyond plan duration; choose none if no registered braking box improves on zero

bank_format_source_reads: replay_bank.py: bank_pairs selects each admitted ex['plan'], falling back to receipt chosen_plan
verify_perseed.py: build_example persists its own plan, candidate_index, seed_index and example_id
mppi_search.py: build_plan emits profile and perturbation_profile relative to policy_traj
plans.py: validate and acceleration_at define legacy knots and knot_s interpolation
variety.py: wall_candidate, gap_open_candidate, ramp_assist_candidate and VARIETY_REGISTERED

coverage: Move validation, immutable members and JSON round-trip
none identity, per-family actor roles and onset/hold boundary seconds
original-base feasibility correction, explicit 1.2 cap, speed/acceleration bounds and infeasible seconds
observable membership, self inclusion, HDV/range exclusion, RNG reproducibility and unavailable geometry
upstream wall sampling, registered window feasibility and current-observation merge release
real mppi_search.build_plan and sample_unscored output formats
real variety wall/gap_open/ramp_assist generator formats, including non-first gap actor
legacy plans.validate knots format and bare-profile fallback
receipt chosen_plan and per_seed_v1/all8 own-plan precedence
positive offsets and weak short impulses prefer none; least-squares depth; six-member projection; malformed inputs
tests.diff_check: git diff --cached --check passed before implementation commit

limitations: Legacy knots and bare absolute profiles have no recorded policy reference; labelling uses a documented per-member median approximation. Modern perturbation_profile records use their exact stored policy-relative offsets.

The shared one-window move vocabulary is a projection of richer variety profiles, including staggered ramp assistance; family/member selection is tag/structure-based, not a global combinatorial nearest-family search.

Offline labels do not certify current observability or authorise execution; online candidates use the acting CAV's observable view. SUMO/WM efficacy and runtime integration belong to the consuming tracks.
